title: A cache in front of the product page
subtitle: What one week of numbers says about the new page cache

scenes.title: Product page load time
scenes.narration: The product page now keeps a copy of each page for one minute, instead of building it again for every visitor. Here is how long the page takes, before and after.

annotation.text: a page nobody asked for in the last minute

steps.say: The typical visit drops from four hundred ten milliseconds to under a hundred.
Nine visits in ten now finish within a hundred forty milliseconds.
The slowest one percent gets only a fifth faster. Those are pages nobody looked at in the last minute, so they are still built from scratch.

scenes.title: Share of visits served from the cache
scenes.narration: Over the week, more visits found a page already in the cache.

steps.say: On the first day, about six visits in ten came from the cache.
By Sunday it was nine in ten, as weekend shoppers kept to the same popular pages.
